page_title: WOL 1-1 KOL | Wolfsburg v FC Koln 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) for a tough tackle.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Marvin Schwabe is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
89' A player from Wolfsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
89' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
87' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
87' Florian Kainz goes off the pitch and Jacob Christensen (1. FC Koln) comes on.
87' Florian Dietz (1. FC Koln) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jan Thielmann.
82' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Joakim Maehle and he is replaced by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg).
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) coming on for Jonas Wind.

82' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
81' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to FC Koln.
80' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' It seemed like Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
77' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
77' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) is booked for saying more than Soren Storks was willing to tolerate.
76' It is time for a substitution. Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) is on for Dejan Ljubicic.
76' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' 7:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
73' A yellow card for a tackle by Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg). Soren Storks doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
71' Here comes a substitution. Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Lovro Majer.
71' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Vaclav Cerny will be replaced by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
71' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
70' FC Koln are ruled offside.
69' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.
68' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
67' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
66' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post.
63' The game has come to an end for Faride Alidou. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
62' Here is a change. Benno Schmitz is going off and Timo Schultz gives the last tactical orders to Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln).
61' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
57' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Soren Storks didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
56' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
55' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
54' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul.
52' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) heads on.
52' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

49' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. Wolfsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+16' Soren Storks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+15' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
45+13' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+13' FC Koln quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
45+12' Surely that's handball by one of the Wolfsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45+9' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+8' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
45+7' Flag up against Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45+6' A mid-range free kick is awarded to FC Koln out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
45+3' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marvin Schwabe intercepts the ball.
45+2' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45+1' A player from FC Koln brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Wolfsburg earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45' The fourth official shows 15 min. of added time.
43' The foul by Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Soren Storks.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) takes a short pass from Joakim Maehle in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
38' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and plants a perfect header into the top left corner.
37' FC Koln will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
37' Rogerio (Wolfsburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Soren Storks blows for a foul.
36' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
34' The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a throw-in.
32' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
30' Good clearance! Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
29' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
20' The game is interrupted.
13' Soren Storks interrupts the game. One of the players from Wolfsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
13' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
11' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) gets inside the box and tries to beat Marvin Schwabe with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
10' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) makes a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
9' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is penalised for holding. Soren Storks signals a set piece. FC Koln have a free kick from a promising distance.
8' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Koen Casteels, who smothers the ball.
7' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
7' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
5' A player from FC Koln commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
4' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' The resulting corner from Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is cleared by the defence.
3' Good chance! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
2' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln), but the defence gets it clear.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Soren Storks is introduced as the referee for today's match.
